description: Rimshot built by modelling a 909-like analogue circuit

params.text: How hard the rimshot is struck
Attack time of the transient that excites the rimshot circuit
Click to sound the rimshot once
How strongly an accent changes the hit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds the rimshot
Modulates how hard the rimshot is struck
A voltage here accents the hit as it is triggered; on some drums that means more level, on others a sharper transient with more harmonics
Modulates the attack of the exciting transient
Modulates the decay of the exciting transient

notes: there is no sequencer or clock here; the drum sounds once for each trigger patched in, or each click on its button
